name: copper(II)
note: Copper(I) is not in 0620, but the name still needs (II).

name: iron(II)
note: 亚 marks the lower charge: 氯化亚铁 = iron(II) chloride.

name: ammonium
note: Not a metal, but it behaves like one in salts.

name: chromium(III)
note: In 0620 only in the test for Cr3+ (12.5).

name: iodide
note: Copper(II) iodide and iron(III) iodide do not exist.

name: hydroxide
note: Silver hydroxide is not stable; ammonium hydroxide is really aqueous ammonia.

name: sulfite
only_with: li; na; k; nh4; mg; ca; ba
note: Only with the ions where the sulfite is well known.
